content:
The task failed because the summary report used a plain numeric format instead of the required comma-separated currency format.
The verifier failed in test_summary_requirements at /tests/test_outputs.py:147 with an AssertionError. Specifically, the test expected the formatted string '27,000.00' but found '$27000.00' in the OUTPUT_SUMMARY file. To fix this, ensure all margin values in the summary text use comma separators for thousands (e.g., using f'{value:,.2f}').
